name: @my-project/plugin-spreadsheet
description: Exposes the SheetJS spreadsheet toolkit to the RunJS sandbox as ctx.libs.xlsx, for reading and writing xlsx/xls/csv files from JS blocks, fields and actions.
description.zh-CN: 把 SheetJS 电子表格工具库注入到 RunJS 沙箱的 ctx.libs.xlsx，便于在 JS 区块、JS 字段、JS 操作中读写 xlsx/xls/csv 文件。
